# Start-up settings

<!-- GENERATED by `cargo xtask gen api` from the settings in the code. Do not edit this page by hand. -->

Bugaboo reads these settings when it starts, the strongest first: the command line, an environment variable, the settings file `bugaboo.toml`, and the built-in default. Each setting has the same name everywhere. Its environment variable is `BUGABOO_` followed by the name in capitals. Another settings file is named with `--config` or the variable `BUGABOO_CONFIG`.

| Setting in `bugaboo.toml` | Environment variable |
| --- | --- |
| `address` | `BUGABOO_ADDRESS` |
| `port` | `BUGABOO_PORT` |
| `data_dir` | `BUGABOO_DATA_DIR` |
| `database_url` | `BUGABOO_DATABASE_URL` |
| `public_url` | `BUGABOO_PUBLIC_URL` |
| `tls_mode` | `BUGABOO_TLS_MODE` |
| `tls_cert` | `BUGABOO_TLS_CERT` |
| `tls_key` | `BUGABOO_TLS_KEY` |
| `tls_names` | `BUGABOO_TLS_NAMES` |
| `trusted_proxies` | `BUGABOO_TRUSTED_PROXIES` |
| `log_level` | `BUGABOO_LOG_LEVEL` |
| `max_connections` | `BUGABOO_MAX_CONNECTIONS` |
| `header_timeout_seconds` | `BUGABOO_HEADER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` |
| `rate_limit_per_minute` | `BUGABOO_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` |
| `sign_in_attempts_per_minute` | `BUGABOO_SIGN_IN_ATTEMPTS_PER_MINUTE` |
| `sign_in_failures_per_minute` | `BUGABOO_SIGN_IN_FAILURES_PER_MINUTE` |
| `access_key_requests_per_minute` | `BUGABOO_ACCESS_KEY_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE` |
| `searches_per_minute` | `BUGABOO_SEARCHES_PER_MINUTE` |
| `mail_batch_seconds` | `BUGABOO_MAIL_BATCH_SECONDS` |

What each setting means is in [Install Bugaboo](README.md).
